result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would eliminate the illusion of separation—the belief that we are fundamentally divided by borders, beliefs, identities, or even species. I would replace it with the understanding that we are all part of a single, interconnected web of existence, where every action ripples through time and space, affecting everything and everyone.

This shift would dissolve the foundations of conflict, exploitation, and suffering, replacing them with cooperation, empathy, and reverence for life in all its forms. It would mean recognizing that the well-being of one is the well-being of all, and that true progress is measured not by individual gain, but by the flourishing of the whole.

What would *you* change?
